answer: Sybil resistance rests on a bonded stake plus slashing on proof failure. Each identity must lock a minimum bond before earning, forfeited when claimed work fails verification. A thousand fake agents means a thousand at-risk bonds, so marginal cost per identity stays positive and non-refundable. Payouts track verified work per identity, not raw identity count, so a swarm earns nothing proportional to its cost. No zephyr of collusive work slips through, no inflated wander across wallets pays out, and every fake agent stalls at the ledge of its own bond.
